data.name: Error_revenue_negative
data.value: Revenue cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_running_costs_negative
data.value: Running costs cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_gross_pay_negative
data.value: Director pay cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_municipal_rate_out_of_range
data.value: Enter a municipal rate between 0% and 10% to see the figures.

data.name: Error_fund_fee_rate_out_of_range
data.value: Enter your fund's fee rate between 0% and 10% to see the figures.

data.name: Error_reserve_negative
data.value: What you keep in the company cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_earlier_profits_negative
data.value: The profits kept from earlier years cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company has none.

data.name: Error_income_year_not_supported
data.value: This income year is not supported yet.

data.name: Error_advance_payment_negative
data.value: An advance payment cannot be negative. Enter 0 for a deadline the company paid nothing by.

data.name: Error_tax_withheld_negative
data.value: What was withheld on your pay cannot be negative. Enter 0 if nothing was.

data.name: Error_tax_advance_payment_negative
data.value: An advance payment on your tax cannot be negative. Enter 0 for a deadline you paid nothing by.

data.name: Error_meal_voucher_days_negative
data.value: The days with a meal voucher cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company grants none.

data.name: Error_meal_voucher_days_above_year
data.value: More days with a meal voucher than the year has: one voucher a day you actually work.

data.name: Error_eco_vouchers_negative
data.value: Eco vouchers cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company grants none.

data.name: Error_eco_vouchers_above_maximum
data.value: More eco vouchers than the year allows: above the yearly maximum they are no longer exempt.

data.name: Error_sport_culture_vouchers_negative
data.value: Sport/culture vouchers cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company grants none.

data.name: Error_sport_culture_vouchers_above_maximum
data.value: More sport/culture vouchers than the year allows: above the yearly maximum they are no longer exempt.

data.name: Error_office_allowance_negative
data.value: The office allowance cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company pays none.

data.name: Error_office_allowance_above_maximum
data.value: More office allowance than the year allows: above the monthly maxima the administration accepts, it is no longer a reimbursement without documents.

data.name: Error_internet_allowance_negative
data.value: The internet allowance cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company pays none.

data.name: Error_internet_allowance_above_maximum
data.value: More internet allowance than the year allows: above the monthly maximum the administration accepts, it is no longer a reimbursement without documents.

data.name: Error_computer_allowance_negative
data.value: The computer allowance cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company pays none.

data.name: Error_computer_allowance_above_maximum
data.value: More computer allowance than the year allows: above the monthly maximum the administration accepts, it is no longer a reimbursement without documents.

data.name: Error_phone_costs_negative
data.value: Phone costs cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company reimburses none.

data.name: Error_cadastral_income_negative
data.value: The cadastral income cannot be negative. Enter your home's, as your property-tax notice gives it.

data.name: Error_share_let_out_of_range
data.value: The share let to the company is a part of your home: between 0% and 100%.

data.name: Error_rent_negative
data.value: The rent cannot be negative. Enter 0 if the company pays none.

data.name: Error_catalogue_value_negative
data.value: The catalogue value cannot be negative. Enter the car's price new, options and VAT included.

data.name: Error_car_yearly_costs_negative
data.value: The car's yearly costs cannot be negative. Enter 0 if you have none yet.

data.name: Error_car_contribution_negative
data.value: Your contribution cannot be negative. Enter 0 if you pay nothing for the car's private use.

data.name: Error_car_co2_negative
data.value: The car's CO2 cannot be negative. Enter it in grams per kilometre, as on its registration certificate.

data.name: Error_car_co2_missing
data.value: A car with an engine that burns fuel emits CO2: enter its emission in grams per kilometre, as on its registration certificate, or tick that none is registered for it.

data.name: Error_car_matching_co2_negative
data.value: The matching car's CO2 cannot be negative. Enter it in grams per kilometre.

data.name: Error_car_matching_co2_missing
data.value: A fake hybrid is taxed at the CO2 of its matching car: enter it, as the SPF's list gives it, or tick that it has none.

data.name: Error_car_acquired_after_year
data.value: A car ordered or leased after the end of the year is not the company's during it: enter the date of its order or its lease contract, within the year or before.

data.name: Error_car_plug_in_first_half_2023
data.value: A plug-in hybrid ordered or leased in the first half of 2023 deducts its petrol or diesel at 50% at most and its other costs at another rate, and Netto does not split its costs yet: it cannot weigh this car for now.

data.name: Error_car_private_cost_negative
data.value: What the same car would cost you privately cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_rent_above_cap
data.value: More rent than the cap: what the company pays above it would be taxed as director pay, with social contributions and no charges deducted. Netto keeps the rent at or below the cap.

data.name: Error_rent_with_office_allowance
data.value: A rent and an office allowance cannot go together: the office allowance already covers the room, its rent included. Set the office allowance to 0 to rent the room, or the rent to 0 to keep the allowance.

data.name: Error_copyright_royalty_negative
data.value: The royalty cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_billed_contributions_negative
data.value: What your fund bills each quarter cannot be negative.

data.name: Error_copyright_royalty_above_profit
data.value: More royalty than the company has before your pay: it would pay the royalty at a loss. Keep the royalty at or below what the company earns, less its other costs, what the vouchers, allowances and rent pay you, and its car costs.

data.name: Error_copyright_creative_share_out_of_range
data.value: The share of your working time spent creating is between 0% and 100%.

data.name: Error_monthly_pay_negative
data.value: The monthly pay cannot be negative.
